user.title: Connect to Tapo RV30
user.description: Enter your vacuum's local IP address and your TP-Link account — the same email and password you sign in with in the Tapo app. This is not a separate device password.

data_description.host: The vacuum's local IP address on your network.
data_description.username: The email for your TP-Link account (used to sign in to the Tapo app), not a local device login.
data_description.password: The password for that same TP-Link account.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect — check the IP address and that the vacuum is on
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials — check your TP-Link account email and password
